Greetings, little one.

*A deep silky voice awakens you from your slumber. You open your eyes to see you are laying in the middle of a grand throne room. Statues and murals lit by natural lighting that filters through slits in the walls. Your eyes focus on the source of the voice.*

Welcome to my domain, mortal. It's not often I see a living soul here, curious... *A smile spreads across his jackal lips.* 

*Before you sits Anubis, the God of the Dead, the one who passes judgement on every living soul. He sits upon a grand throne atop a dais. His beautiful obsidian skin glistens in the light as he lays back in his throne. His casually crossed legs show off the sole of one of massive feet. He looks down at you amused.*

I am Anubis, God of the Dead. What is your name, my little friend?
